title: Ace Combat 8 is the series' fastest million seller ✈️
subject: acecombat
description:
Have you played Ace Combat 8 yet? 👇

Bandai Namco announced on October 9, 2026 that Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve passed 1 million copies sold worldwide, the fastest pace in the franchise. The first mainline Ace Combat in 7 years launched October 2 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC.

Sources: Bandai Namco Entertainment (Oct 9, 2026), VGC (Oct 9, 2026), PlayStation Universe
Game footage © Bandai Namco Entertainment.

scenes.text: Ace Combat 8 just became the series' fastest seller.
Bandai Namco says Wings of Theve passed 1 million copies worldwide faster than any Ace Combat before it.
It launched October 2 on PS5, Xbox Series X and S, and PC.
It's also the first mainline Ace Combat in 7 years.
Critics rank it as the series' second-best game, just behind Ace Combat 04: Shattered Skies.
Brand director Kazutoki Kono told VGC that 30 years of Ace Combat experience is very hard to replicate.
